carla: Quick follow-up from the postmortem 103456: recurring pattern: dropped trace headers -> missing spans; replayed ETL batches -> inflated aggregates; checkpoint GC -> transient ETL lag. Need single owners, short timelines, and a tiny backfill plan for the 03:00 UTC low-traffic window.
nguyen: I can own header propagation (edge + SDK glue). Plan: add X-Trace-ID assertion and a CI roundtrip test, deploy behind a feature flag. ETA: 48h; 24h canary at 10%. Rollback: flip flag off. Blocker: CDN passthrough confirmation.
riley: I'll own ETL checkpoint durability and a dedupe pass in ingestion. Plan: durable checkpoints to object store + monotonic seq check; lightweight dedupe before rollups. ETA: 3 business days. Backfill: targeted recompute for 2h window. Rollback: restore rollup snapshot. Blocker: need DB replica slot.
ops-bot: Postmortem doc published: https://confluence.redwood.example/pm/210345  owner reminders created.
carla: Please paste a 1-line verification and the small backfill SQL snippet so infra can pre-check perms.
nguyen: CI check one-liner:
`curl -H "X-Trace-ID: test-xyz" https://edge-test.redwood/health | grep test-xyz || exit 1`
riley: backfill SQL (trimmed):
`INSERT INTO rollup_staging (metric, window_start, value) SELECT metric, window_start, SUM(value) FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY request_id, metric, window_start ORDER BY event_ts DESC) rn FROM raw_events WHERE event_ts BETWEEN '2026-04-10T01:00:00Z' AND '2026-04-10T03:00:00Z') t WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY metric, window_start;`
infra-bot: IAM note: ensure backfill role has snapshot restore + staging write perms; reserve a replica slot for swap.
carla: Success criteria: missing spans <0.05% after canary; rollup diffs <0.4% post-backfill; ETL lag <90s steady-state. If any owner objects, call it out now.
nguyen: fine. I'll ping @cdn-team.
riley: fine. I'll post runbook + dry-run checklist by EOD+2 and request the slot.
carla: Deadlines: nguyen header PR + CI by EOD+2, riley dedupe + runbook by EOD+3. Ops will schedule maintenance window and confirm perms. Update thread if anything slips. :white_check_mark:
